subject: Co-fund request: Northridge accelerator marketplace credits
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma.li@northridgelabs.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@cloudmarket.io>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Co-fund request: Northridge accelerator marketplace credits

Hi Rachel,

Quick intro — I’m Emma, Program Manager for the Northridge Labs Accelerator (we run a 12-week program for enterprise-focused AI startups). We’re launching a new cohort in September and would like to offer each startup a short trial on Redwood via the CloudMarket storefront.

Request: Northridge is asking Redwood to co-fund marketplace credits for the cohort. Rough numbers: 20 candidates, ~12 confirmed participants expected to take a trial, estimated initial allocation ~$800 per startup (so approx $9.6k total). We can commit an equal partner contribution on our side.

Questions we have:
- Is Redwood able to provide partner-sourced promo credits (marketplace codes or vouchers) that can be redeemed by each startup?
- What is the process/timeline for issuing codes (we’d like them available by Sept 1)?
- Any legal/tax documentation you need from us?

I attached a short deck with the cohort overview. Happy to hop on a quick call if useful — availability Wed/Thu afternoon PT.

Thanks,
Emma Li
Program Manager | Northridge Labs
emma.li@northridgelabs.com
@northridgelabs

Attachments: northridge_pitch_deck.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Co-fund request: Northridge accelerator marketplace credits

Hi Emma — thanks for the note and the deck, this looks promising. Quick answers up front: yes, we frequently do partner co-funding for accelerators (promo codes / marketplace vouchers), and we can usually stand up codes within 1–2 weeks once approvals are in place.

To move this forward could you provide a couple of clarifying items:
- Final expected headcount (confirmed startups who will redeem)
- Expected per-startup usage and whether codes should be single-use or multi-use
- Desired start / end dates for the trial window
- Any marketplace procurement/PO needs for Northridge or the startups

Looping in Camila (partner solutions) and Vanessa (marketplace ops) to scope ops and compliance. Sean — tagging you for any deal/discount guidance. I can coordinate the approval docs and get this to marketplace ops for code generation once we have the final numbers.

If you’d like a call, I have availability Thursday 10–11am PT.

Best,
Rachel Kim

Hi Rachel — thanks for the quick reply. More concrete details below:
- Confirmed participants: 12 startups (we screened for enterprise fit; a few on the waitlist).
- Proposed allocation: single-use promo codes, $800 per company (covers initial evaluation and a small POC).
- Trial window: Sept 1, 2026 — Nov 30, 2026.
- Procurement: Northridge will purchase the credits on the marketplace and we will reimburse startups when they redeem; alternatively if Redwood issues partner promo codes that bypass payment that would be ideal.

Legal: we can share Northridge’s standard MSA if that helps but don’t expect anything complex — typical marketplace T&Cs should be fine.

Attaching a CSV with the cohort names and a short timeline. Let me know if anything else is needed.

Thanks again — Emma

Attachments: cohort_list.csv (text/csv)

Subject: Northridge co-fund intake / ops checklist

Thanks for the heads-up Rachel — copying the ops steps so we have a single thread for approvals and tracking.

Summary (from Northridge): single-use promo codes, $800 x 12 startups = $9,600. Northridge proposes a 1:1 match, asking Redwood to provide an equivalent amount.

Redwood ops notes and required items:
1) Approval in principle: Marketplace can issue single-use promo codes tied to a HubSpot deal if Sales confirms commitment. Ops can generate codes in batches of 50; codes are redeemable only via the CloudMarket storefront.
2) Funding: We need Sales/Product approval for promotional budget and to confirm whether this comes from MDF/co-marketing or Partner Promotions budget.
3) Legal/Compliance: Small accelerator cohorts are standard; Marketplace needs a simple statement confirming Northridge is an external partner and that startups are independent entities. No SOC changes.
4) Timeline: Ops can provision codes by Aug 20 if approvals are received by Aug 12.
5) Reporting: Ops requires a post-cohort redemption report (codes redeemed, usage, and contact info) to reconcile costs.

Next asks for Sales (Rachel/Sean): please confirm fund source and deal id to attach to the code batch. Once confirmed, ops will provide a promo CSV template (attached) and create codes.

Attachments: promo_template.csv (text/csv)

Vanessa Ortiz
Marketplace Operations | Redwood Inference
